title: Add plural resource tasks_restored_count
description: Add the plural resource used to localize the data-restore success toast ("%1$d task restored!" / "%1$d tasks restored!").
acceptance_criteria: app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml gains a <plurals name="tasks_restored_count"> with "one" item "%1$d task restored!" and "other" item "%1$d tasks restored!"
exact_code:
<plurals name="tasks_restored_count">
        <item quantity="one">%1$d task restored!</item>
        <item quantity="other">%1$d tasks restored!</item>
    </plurals>
